# Diz Toba

> Diz Toba is a London-based singer-songwriter, performer and musician. The latest release is the single "Venom & Lemonade", out now.

The official site, diztoba.com, is a single page with the current release, upcoming live shows and a mailing list sign-up.

## Music

- [Venom & Lemonade](https://diztoba.com/): New single, out now. "Sweet on the tongue, sharp on the way down. A summer song for the ones who bite."
- [SoundCloud](https://www.soundcloud.com/diztoba): Listen to releases
- [YouTube](https://youtube.com/@diztoba): Watch videos

## Live

- [Upcoming shows](https://diztoba.com/): Dates, venues and ticket links

## Profiles

- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/diztoba)
